string.name: desc
string.value: Lets you use skills without spending MP and has a chance to trigger Power Stance on hit. Continually recovers HP and MP, and increases the damage of all attack magic. Enemy attacks will not remove this effect. [Cooldown: 3 min]

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, Recovers HP and MP by #y% every 4 secs, Increases damage by Magic ATT by #damage% every 4 sec, Chance of Activation Power Stance Effect: #prop%, Duration: #time sec

string.name: pdesc
string.value: Enables one to use skills without spending mana, and stance effect will trigger on hit with a set probability. Continues to recover HP and MP and increases the damage of all attack magic. [Cooldown: 3 min]
